title: Ram Janmabhoomi Return Of A Splendid Sun
original_title: Ram Janmabhoomi Return Of A Splendid Sun
overview: January 22, 2024, will always be marked as a monumental day in the history of India. After years, Ram Mandir was finally built in the lands of Ayodhya. Soon after the inauguration, JioCinema announced that it will premiere the documentary 'Ram Janmabhoomi Temple: The Return of a Splendid Sun' on January 25
